case_name: Dr. A. R. Sircar v State of Uttar Pradesh and Others
holding: The University will determine the point of time when the appellant could have been appointed on the substantive post of Professor of Medicine had there been no prohibition against the implementation of the select list. The University will decide on the premise that had there been no intervening stay against the implementation of the select list prepared pursuant to the advertisement of December 1984 what would have been the date of appointment of the appellant.
cases_cited: Dr. A. R. Sircar v State of Uttar Pradesh
